jd:
Acme Cloud Systems is hiring a Software Engineer to join our platform team.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of professional experience building backend services in Python
- Hands-on experience deploying services on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda)
- Experience containerizing applications with Docker
- Familiarity building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have:
- Experience with Kubernetes
- Exposure to infrastructure as code (Terraform)

Acme Cloud Systems is an equal opportunity employer.
